description: Read a public status page hosted on nslookup.io status pages. Returns the page name, overall status, per-component status and uptime, and active incidents/maintenance. Look up by slug (pages served at hosted.nslookup.io/<slug>) or by the custom domain the page is served on. Provide exactly one of slug or domain.

domain.description: Custom domain the status page is served on (e.g. status.acme.com)

name: status_page
